attributes.risk_rating_note: Thermal ageing can gradually bias the infrared measurement while the sensor remains active → Occ Medium. Reference checks and comparison with the other sensing channels detect most relevant drift, but small plausible biases may remain latent → Det Good capability.

This subsystem-level effect aggregates sensing degradation, supply interruption, measurement drift, and compute defects → Occ Medium. Channel-quality monitoring, cross-sensor plausibility checks, and compute supervision reveal most degraded fused outputs → Det Good capability.

Processor execution or memory integrity defects in a proven compute module are unlikely → Occ Low. Watchdog, ECC, memory tests, control-flow supervision, and result plausibility checks cover most but not all manifestations → Det Good capability.

The externally mounted sensor experiences temperature cycling over its service life, making gradual sensitivity or calibration degradation credible → Occ High. Signal-quality metrics and cross-sensor plausibility checks detect most, but not all, gradual degradation across operating conditions → Det Good capability.

Supply degradation or intermittent power in an established LiDAR unit is plausible over its service life → Occ Medium. Rail supervision, brown-out detection, reset monitoring, and output aliveness checks reliably reveal the interruption → Det High capability.
